characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: sections ground with SiC papers, polished with 1 µm and 0.25 µm diamond pastes, then chemically etched with saturated picric acid solution
characterization_methods.purpose: measure equivalent diameter of each prior austenite grain (PAG)

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: SU5000 scanning electron microscope equipped with EBSD detector
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: electrolytically polished in 10% perchlorate alcohol solution at 30 V and 0.25 A for 30 s; step size 0.65–1.3 µm

characterization_methods.purpose: reconstruct PAGs from EBSD diagrams based on the Greninger-Troiano (GT) orientation relationship
characterization_methods.technique: Prior austenite grain (PAG) reconstruction from EBSD

characterization_methods.key_findings: at 0.9 strain the side-section DRX fraction map gives 79.3%
characterization_methods.purpose: distinguish recrystallized grains from deformed ones
calculate equivalent diameter of each PAG based on the corresponding area in metallography

computational_details.boundary_and_initial_conditions: RVE 550 µm × 550 µm × 550 µm; cell size L0 = 2.5 µm; initial dislocation density uniform 10^11 m^-2; load condition 850 °C, 0.01 s^-1 to true strain 0.9
computational_details.simulation_method: 3D cellular automaton (CA) with inhomogeneous dislocation density and grain boundary sliding
computational_details.validation_against_experiment: predicted flow stress well matched experiment at 0.01 s^-1; simulated AGS 34.53 µm and DRX fraction 84.98% closely matched reconstructed side-section AGS 34.01±4.71 µm and DRX fraction 79.3%

computational_details.simulation_method: finite element simulation of hot compression using DEFORM 3D with embedded constitutive model
computational_details.validation_against_experiment: accuracy of the simulation was verified in constant and varying deformation conditions by comparing experimental results

interfaces.phase_evolution: Incomplete DRX at 0.9 strain (experimental DRX fraction 79.3%); elongated matrix still visible despite low strain rate promoting DRX nucleation and grain growth.

phase_interfaces.coherence: high-angle grain boundary; PAG boundaries taken at misorientation >10°

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: 加热至1250 °C并保温180 s以均匀化奥氏体相。
在850 °C保温60 s以减小温度波动。
在850 °C、0.01 s^-1恒定应变速率下压缩至真应变0.9（ε_total=0.9）。
变形后立即水淬以冻结高温组织形貌。

measurement_conditions.environment: Gleeble 1500 thermomechanical simulator; tantalum foil (0.1 mm) between specimen ends and indenter to prevent interfacial melting and minimize friction
measurement_conditions.other_conditions: compressed to true strain 0.9; water quenched immediately after deformation
measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: cylindrical specimen φ6 mm × 9 mm (cut along rolling direction)

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: Flow stress–true strain curve rises steeply and plateaus just above the 105 MPa gridline (within the 100–125 MPa band) at 850 °C, 0.01 s⁻¹; all 850 °C curves rise monotonically with only a late plateau (no DRX-type peak).

grain_structure.grain_size_distribution: SD 54.54 µm; Min 10.22 µm; Max 265.20 µm (experimental metallograph, 2D)

microstructure_list.region: initial state (representative area 550 µm × 550 µm on different sections)

structures.overall_structure: 初始混合晶粒组织（mixed-grain state），由三个互相垂直的蚀刻截面拼接显示，存在粗细晶混合分布。

grain_structure.grain_size_distribution: Side section 34.01±4.71 µm (experimental); simulated 3D CA AGS 34.53 µm; 2D(YZ surface) 32.94 µm

phases_present.morphology: as-quenched martensitic matrix (prior austenite grains reconstructed from EBSD)

structures.overall_structure: 850 °C、0.01 s^-1 热压缩至真应变0.9后水淬的板条马氏体组织（原奥氏体晶粒由EBSD重建），呈不完全动态再结晶状态；实验侧截面DRX分数约79.3%。

unmapped_findings: 在850 °C、0.01 s⁻¹下，DRX分数随时间的实验/模拟曲线（Fig. 6a）末端约为0.72（约50–60 s）；850 °C四条曲线均未达到1.0，显示不完全再结晶。[figure_006]
2D(YZ surface)重建结果标注32.94 µm、DRX分数76.4%；侧截面DRX分数图标注79.3%。[figure_012]
初始位错密度在所有变形条件下假设为均匀的10^11 m^-2（用于CA模拟的初始条件）。[b0091]
